goal: Prove a bounded Apex-owned AgentDefinition projection adapter without granting executor ownership of Apex semantics or authority.
scope: definition identity, registry revision, and digest binding
fail-closed adapter rejection and bounded invocation
attempt identity and result transport preservation
AC-DEV-017 matching and AC-DEV-018 admission reconciliation after proof
out_of_scope: native Goose or Freebuff catalog claims
permanent executor selection or executor-native catalog ownership
executor authority over task semantics, scheduling, verification, retry/recovery, or semantic success
ECC installation, credential handling, or production execution
architecture_constraints: Apex owns canonical AgentDefinition identity and capability metadata
the adapter receives only an immutable task-scoped projection containing definition_id, registry_revision, definition_digest, and bounded payload
projection integrity and identity binding are checked before invocation
missing, malformed, stale, mismatched, or replayed identity material fails closed without invocation
the executor remains an execution substrate and cannot define Apex claims, elevate authority, or assign semantic success
Apex retains task semantics, scheduling, authority, verification, retry/recovery, and reconciliation
AC-DEV-018 remains BLOCKED_CAPABILITY until accepted operational proof and admission reconciliation
acceptance_criteria: projection bytes, registry revision, definition_id, and definition_digest remain bound and tamper-evident across the adapter boundary
attempt identity is preserved from Apex projection through bounded invocation and result transport
missing, malformed, stale, mismatched, or replayed projections are rejected fail-closed before invocation
accepted invocation cannot elevate authority or assign Apex semantic success
the proof uses a disposable/local bounded harness with no permanent executor selection, ECC installation, or unrestricted dispatch
durable evidence distinguishes adapter operational proof from source/documentation evidence
AC-DEV-017 matching and AC-DEV-018 admission are rerun and only reconciled if the accepted contract is actually demonstrated
validation: focused adapter contract and fail-closed tests
registry, backlog, Passport, and admission-policy validation
full Python test suite, documentation validation, git diff --check, and protected CI gate
